steps.instruction: Prepare serial dilutions of SB-203580 (CHEMBL10) in DMSO plus vehicle control.
Mix compound, recombinant MAPK9, peptide substrate, and ATP; incubate.
Stop reaction, deplete ATP, add ADP detection reagent, measure luminescence.

rationale: ADP-Glo measures ADP produced, suitable for kinase inhibition; serial dilution covers expected range based on similar compounds.
limitations: Enzyme, substrate, ATP concentrations, reaction time, temperature, and detection volumes are not supported by provided evidence; must be optimized empirically.
